create_IterTimerHook: create an IterTimerHook instance to log iteration timing during training
use_IterTimerHook_before_train: use IterTimerHook before_train method to synchronize iteration count after resuming from checkpoints
use_IterTimerHook_before_iter: use IterTimerHook _before_iter method to calculate and log data loading time per batch
use_IterTimerHook_after_iter: use IterTimerHook _after_iter method to calculate iteration time and update ETA for training
register_IterTimerHook: register IterTimerHook in the HOOKS registry to automatically track data_time and iteration time
